id: arrival FB19: D0 -> K-A -> 1a -> K-C -> M0-W fix1
author: motion-agent
decision: FB19 (owner 2026-11-26, 'מאשר את שניהם'): one first-person walk, scroll-scrubbable; replaces door-in-code, 1b, the junction look-around, clip 2 and T-E0-W
sampling: uniform in time at the nominal walk: frame i (1-based) of a variant is shown at (i - 1) / fps s; the picture moves at an even rate (0.5x-1.6x of the median picture speed, eased in from D0 over 0.5 s and out onto M0-W over 0.7 s), so a scroll step of N frames shows the same amount of motion anywhere; forward only, no hold, no cut

1080.note: each frame the mean of the 60 fps frames around it (0.25, 0.5, 0.25); the first and last are the stills

first_frame: D0: door-2026-11-16/d0.png, its 16:9 frame (finish.frame_view) = the site's d0 rest image; 0 difference before encoding
last_frame: M0-W fix1: fb13-2026-11-25/default-frame-m0w-fix1.png; 0 difference before encoding (AVIF 1920 mean 2.35 levels, p99 11)

swap.at_end: after the last frame, the room's live layers (the same picture with the defaults); a variant the visitor chose blends in over 200 ms
swap.at_start: the D0 rest image is frame 1

locks.1a: FB16 grade ramped in from 2.0 m to 3.8 m; end -> HT2 fb16
locks.K-C: ends -> HT2 fb16 / M0-W fix1 (12 frames)

checks.old_table_or_old_living_room: 0: 1a and HT2 see only the window wall from the hall (0 px of M0-W in HT2); K-C draws the fix1 room (Olia table)
